item.title: Deep Learning Modeling Textbook: Reproducible Experiments for Manufacturing Data
item.description:
Project resources

The public learning repository and its evidence status.

  • GitHub repositorygithub.com/HeungJAELEE/Deep_Learning_Text_book

No separate public report is registered. This article remains a learning and experiment-design document and does not add unsupported implementation or model-performance claims.

Public PDD · Learning Backlog

Project definition and execution plan

The plan avoids overstating the current repository and turns reproducibility, manufacturing metrics, and implementation gaps into a visible learning backlog.

Design baseline public · implementation validation pending
Project type
Personal learning and experiment design
My scope
Modeling standards, experiment structure, validation plan
Primary audience
AI learners and manufacturing data analysts
Evidence level
Limited public repository · design-led

Problem

A notebook that runs once does not prove leakage control, preprocessing consistency, reproducibility, baseline improvement, or the cost of manufacturing errors.

item.title: Collaborative-Robot Automotive Digital Twin and Edge Vision AI
item.description:
Project resources

The team presentation and related public robot-HMI implementation.

  • Related GitHub repositorygithub.com/HeungJAELEE/Busan_Robot
  • Automotive Digital Twin team report/docs/Robot_Digital_Twin.pdf

Only values directly visible in the team PDF are treated as measured: F1 1.00 and 0.877, plus a Pi5 5 FPS to Pi5+Hailo-10H 18 FPS comparison. The repository is a related PC-HMI extension, not a one-to-one copy of the complete team deliverable.

Public PDD · Delivery Record

Project definition and execution plan

The team project is presented as a product-traceability flow from QR and MES through robots, vision, PLC, and the digital twin, with explicit phase and ownership boundaries.

item.description:

A dedicated public source repository and separate public report have not been registered for this PoC. The article describes the design and verification boundary without labeling another repository as its source.

Public PDD · Prototype Backlog

Project definition and execution plan

The PoC prioritizes fact traceability, personal-data minimization, and structured validation before polished LLM wording.

PoC design public · dedicated source not public
Project type
Personal LLM application PoC
My scope
React, Flask, LLM boundaries and validation design
Primary audience
Job seekers and career-document authors
Evidence level
Design-led · no dedicated repository registered

Problem

If polished LLM wording changes dates, roles, or metrics, or sends unnecessary personal data to an external API, the resume becomes less trustworthy.
